dataset: USGS Data Series 684, DEM 1, North-Central California Coast
selection: First complete 8 by 6 original window in top-to-bottom then left-to-right order with every value present and within 10 metres of its first sample.
derivation: Original sample tokens retained unchanged; dimensions and lower-left origin rewritten only to describe the selected window. No interpolation or added observation.
use: Historical public source-acquisition control. Acknowledge USGS, the dataset originator. Not suitable for navigation. Hypothetical surface and rainfall settings are not observed site conditions; successful import is not environmental prediction validation.
uncertainty: No per-sample uncertainty is supplied by this ASCII input. Metadata altitude resolution is not interpreted as measurement uncertainty.
